title: Washington Township Historical Society Museum

services.name: Walking Tour
services.desc: The Washington Township Historical Society (WTHS) has launched the Self-Guided Walking Tour with the goal of attracting history enthusiasts, regional tourists, and day-trip visitors seeking commemorative experiences in New Jersey. The Self-Guided Walking Tour features an interactive digital map highlighting historic properties that existed 250 years ago in German Valley. Visitors may use their mobile devices to read written descriptions and view images, and/or hear audio narrations of each site. Forthcoming written and audio are planned in Spanish, and German. This self-guided walking tour highlights properties that existed during the Revolutionary War era and helped shape our community.

blurb: The Washington Township Historical Society was founded in 1960 and incorporated in 1961 by a group of concerned citizens who were committed to saving the historic 1774 Union Church ruins from demolition. Many of those first members were descendants of Washington Township's founding families. Since that time, the Society has contributed to preserving historic township structures at risk.
